title: Circle companions of Hardy spaces of the unit disk
summary: This paper gives a complete answer to the following problem: Find the circle companion of the Hardy space of the unit disk with values in the space of all bounded linear operators between two separable Hilbert spaces. Classically, the problem asks whether for each function $h$ on the unit {\it disk}, there exists a ``boundary function" $bh$ on the unit {\it circle} such that the mapping $bh\mapsto h$ is an isometric isomorphism between Hardy spaces of the unit circle and the unit disk with values in some Banach space.
